sources: Ministry of Finance small savings rates Oct-Dec 2026 (news: Outlook Money, stableinvestor)

companies.kind: Government (small savings via post offices and authorised banks)
Pension regulator and pension fund managers

companies.provider: Government of India (Ministry of Labour & Employment)
Government of India (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare)

entries.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
entries.note: 7.1% p.a. (Oct-Dec 2026), EEE tax status; 15-yr lock-in, extendable in 5-yr blocks; Rs 500-1.5 lakh/yr

entries.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
entries.note: 8.2% p.a. (Oct-Dec 2026); for girl child under 10; deposits for 15 yrs, matures at 21 yrs; Rs 250-1.5 lakh/yr, 80C

entries.name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
entries.note: 8.2% p.a. paid quarterly (Oct-Dec 2026); age 60+ (55+ for VRS); 5-yr tenure, extendable 3 yrs; max Rs 30 lakh

entries.name: National Savings Certificate (NSC VIII Issue)
entries.note: 7.7% p.a. compounded annually (Oct-Dec 2026); 5-yr lock-in; 80C eligible

entries.name: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)
entries.note: 7.5% p.a. (Oct-Dec 2026); doubles money in 115 months; lock-in 2.5 yrs

entries.name: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS)
entries.note: 7.4% p.a. paid monthly (Oct-Dec 2026); 5-yr tenure; max Rs 9 lakh single / Rs 15 lakh joint

entries.name: Post Office Recurring Deposit (RD)
entries.note: 6.7% p.a. compounded quarterly (Oct-Dec 2026); 5-yr tenure; min Rs 100/month

entries.name: Post Office Savings Account
entries.note: 4.0% p.a.; min balance Rs 500; no lock-in

entries.name: National Pension System (NPS) Tier I
entries.note: Market-linked (equity/corporate debt/G-sec/alternate); locked till 60; up to 80% lump sum at exit for non-govt subscribers (corpus > Rs 12 lakh); extra Rs 50,000 deduction u/s 80CCD(1B)

entries.name: National Pension System (NPS) Tier II
entries.note: Voluntary market-linked account with no lock-in; requires Tier I account

entries.name: NPS Vatsalya
entries.note: NPS for minors opened by parent/guardian; min Rs 250/yr (2026 rules); partial withdrawals after 3 yrs for education/illness; converts to NPS Tier I at 18

entries.name: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)
entries.note: For central govt employees under NPS who opt in; assured pension of 50% of last 12-month avg basic pay after 25 yrs service; min Rs 10,000/month after 10 yrs

entries.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
entries.note: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000-5,000/month from 60; age 18-40, non-income-taxpayers; contributions till 60

entries.name: Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)
entries.note: 8.25% p.a. for FY 2025-26; 12% employee + employer contribution; for salaried employees in covered establishments

entries.name: Voluntary Provident Fund (VPF)
entries.note: Extra voluntary contribution over 12% into EPF; earns EPF rate (8.25% FY 2025-26); interest taxable on employee contributions above Rs 2.5 lakh/yr

entries.name: Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS-95)
entries.note: 8.33% of employer EPF share (wage ceiling Rs 15,000) funds a monthly pension after 10 yrs service; min pension Rs 1,000/month

entries.name: General Provident Fund (GPF)
entries.note: For govt employees under the old pension scheme; rate notified quarterly, usually in line with PPF (7.1%)

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
entries.provider: Government of India (Ministry of Labour & Employment)
entries.note: Rs 3,000/month pension from 60 for unorganised workers aged 18-40 earning up to Rs 15,000/month; Rs 55-200/month contribution matched by govt

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
entries.provider: Government of India (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare)
entries.note: Rs 3,000/month pension from 60 for small and marginal farmers aged 18-40; Rs 55-200/month contribution matched by govt

entries.name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
entries.note: MP state scheme: staged payments to registered girls through schooling plus a lump sum (about Rs 1 lakh) on completing conditions at 21

entries.name: Bhagyalakshmi Scheme
entries.note: Karnataka state scheme for girls in BPL families; govt deposit matures to a lump sum at 18 subject to conditions

entries.name: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme
entries.note: TN state scheme: govt fixed deposit (via TN Power Finance) in girl child's name, paid out at 18

entries.name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
entries.note: Delhi govt deposits at birth and school milestones; maturity amount paid at 18 after Class 10

entries.name: Lek Ladki Yojana
entries.note: Maharashtra scheme for girls in yellow/orange ration card families: staged payments totalling Rs 1,01,000 up to age 18
